story.script: I discovered it after an executive asked why I had waited until launch week to raise a serious risk. I had raised it a month earlier. story.twist: An executive asks her to explain one 'late concern,' and she opens the original thread where the coworker's reply says the risk is not worth discussing.

youtube.description: Leadership thought I raised risks too late. The original messages showed why.

story.script: For two weeks my manager kept adding a new employee to my client calls and asking me to explain every decision afterward. He called it backup coverage. She said my manager had recruited her specifically to take over my account because I was supposedly transitioning to less client-facing work. Nobody had discussed that with me. He argued that I should see it as recognition because only I could transfer the account properly.
